newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hon HaiPrecision unit loan allotted.
newsitem.headline: Hon HaiPrecision unit loan allotted.

text.p: Foxconn (Far East) Holding Ltd and Foxteq Holding Inc's US$90 million loan facility has been allotted, arranger Sumitomo Bank said.
The three-year loan, which attracted US$120 million in commitments, was not increased.
The facility is guaranteed by Hon Hai Precision Industries Corp, which wholly owns the two borrowers, and includes an 18-month grace period.
It pays an interest margin of 38 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Co-ordinating arranger BA Asia committed US$11 million.
Arrangers Chase Manhattan Asia committed US$11 million, and Sumitomo Bank US$7.5 million.
Co-arrangers Sumitomo Trust and Banking committed US$11 million and Credit Lyonnais committed US$6.5 million.
Fellow co-arrangers Commerz East Asia, Royal Bank of Canada and WestLB Asia Pacific each committed S$5.5 million.
Participant Australia and New Zealand Banking Group committed US$6.5 million.
Other participating banks (each with US$4 million) were Chinatrust Commercial Bank, Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank, Development Bank of Singapore, Norinchukin Bank and Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank.
